profile.name: Aditya Malviya
profile.tagline: I build data pipelines that hold up in production.
profile.availability: Open to Senior Data Engineer roles · Mumbai · Hybrid
profile.bio: Senior Data Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services with nearly 5 years across two client accounts, Rolls-Royce Digital and Avery Dennison (Smartrac). I design and own production lakehouse pipelines with PySpark, SQL/T-SQL, Python, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, processing ~27 GB/day of streaming data (Event Hubs, Kafka, Structured Streaming) and 5-7 GB/day of batch data. I lead a 6-member offshore team as Scrum Master: stand-ups, boards, pull-request approvals and delivery to the client.
profile.bioSecondary: I care about the unglamorous parts — the skewed join that quietly costs an hour a night, the cluster that is three sizes too big, the pipeline nobody can redeploy safely. Fixing those is most of the job.

experience.summary: Designing, running and leading production lakehouse data engineering on Microsoft Azure for the Rolls-Royce Digital account.

projects.name: Engine History Analysis
highlights: Design and own production ADF and Azure Databricks ETL/ELT pipelines in PySpark and Spark SQL on a Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) over Delta Lake and ADLS Gen2, processing ~27 GB/day of streaming and 5-7 GB/day of batch engine data into star-schema models for Power BI reporting.

Built real-time ingestion with Azure Event Hubs, Apache Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming into Delta Lake, alongside incremental batch loads using Delta MERGE, SCD Type 2 and Auto Loader, orchestrated with Databricks Workflows.
Cut a critical Spark job's runtime by ~73% (52 to 14 minutes) by fixing join skew with key salting and Adaptive Query Execution, eliminating recurring executor out-of-memory failures.
Reduced Azure costs by ~40% through cluster right-sizing, Delta OPTIMIZE, Z-ORDER and partitioning, and parameterized ADF pipelines.
Implemented data quality checks at every medallion layer and Unity Catalog governance (RBAC, fine-grained permissions, lineage); secrets via Azure Key Vault-backed scopes and service principals.

Since 2025, lead a 6-member offshore team as Scrum Master: daily stand-ups, sprint planning, Azure DevOps boards, mentoring juniors and approving their pull requests, and owning delivery commitments to the client.
Use AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude and ChatGPT in VS Code) to automate repetitive coding and test writing and raise code quality across the team.
Collaborate with the DevOps team on Azure DevOps CI/CD releases for ADF and Databricks code; working knowledge of YAML pipelines and Git branching.

projects.name: Assumptions Management
highlights: Built production FastAPI (Python) data services with RBAC and Azure API Management over MS SQL Server and Azure Blob Storage, containerized with Docker.
Improved performance by ~30% via Redis caching and SQL/T-SQL and database-logic optimization.
Resolved SonarQube findings and wrote Pytest unit tests within Agile/Scrum sprints on Azure DevOps Boards.
Early on, shadowed client technical walkthroughs and leadership reviews to learn the Rolls-Royce domain.

projects.title: DataLens
projects.subtitle: Browser-native data profiling and quality workspace
projects.description: Privacy-first workspace for profiling CSV, Parquet, JSON and Excel files entirely in the browser. DuckDB-WASM powers set-based profiling, explainable quality scoring, adaptive visualizations, a SQL console and reproducible cleaning exports without uploading source data.

projects.title: FlowForge
projects.subtitle: Visual ETL builder with production-code export
projects.description: Graph-based ETL designer with live DuckDB-WASM execution, schema-aware joins and data-quality checks. A single pipeline graph exports equivalent DuckDB SQL, Spark SQL, PySpark and a ready-to-run dbt project.

projects.title: PipeScope
projects.subtitle: Spark diagnostics and column-level lineage
projects.description: Browser-based Spark event-log doctor and SQL/dbt lineage explorer. It combines evidence-backed tuning findings, stage and SQL timelines, column-level impact analysis and a critical-path overlay while keeping logs and SQL local.
